messages:
laura: Heads-up: MedTechCo procurement wants a short POC checklist: redacted ISO excerpt, SOC2 summary, signed pen-test attestation, and a 4h weekend vuln scan. They asked whether Redwood will run the scan or they should run it. cc @ben @anita

ben: We can provide redacted ISO + SOC2 summary. Pen-test attestation is our standard doc; security needs to sign. If Redwood runs the scan we need ATO + SSO access for the engineer.

anita: Ops note: weekend slot ok but require firewall allowlist at least 24h prior. Hosted scanner IPs: 54.210.11.7, 54.210.11.8. Bastion option available with SSH fingerprint on request.

laura: MedTechCo prefers Redwood to run it and requested Sunday 01:00-05:00 UTC. They also want the attestation signed within 48h.

ben: Pricing: artifact exchange included. Scan facilitation / hands-on ops is billable. Recommend $1,000 as "POC scan facilitation & reporting (up to 4h)". I'll add to quote and attach attestation template.

ops-bot: REMINDER: For Redwood-run scans provide: completed ATO form, SSO invite for engineer, firewall allowlist for 54.210.11.7/8 24h prior.

laura: I'll upload redacted ISO and post a presigned link once ready. Ben please attach the attestation template to the opportunity. Finance please add the $1,000 line explicitly named.

finance: Added quote line as requested: "POC scan facilitation & reporting (up to 4h) - $1,000". Marked as billable.

anita: Confirming IPs again: 54.210.11.7, 54.210.11.8. Bastion IP option: 54.210.11.9. Need allowlist confirmation before starting.

laura: Uploaded redacted ISO and posted presign (placeholder): https://redwood-proofs.s3.amazonaws.com/medtechco/iso-redacted-presign?token=XYZ. I'll follow up with procurement to confirm allowlist and accept the quote.

ben: Attached pen-test attestation template to CRM and noted manager approval required for signature. If legal redlines, escalate to #sec-legal; could add 1-2 business days.

laura: Great, thanks everyone. Next steps: customer confirms allowlist and ATO, finance collects PO, security signs attestation. I'll close loop with procurement afterwards. :thumbsup:
